cinematic.note: Misty teal, distant lanterns, a dark Victorian suit. Moody and filmic.

cozy.note: Lanterns and candles everywhere. Unmistakably cozy, a touch much.

epic.note: Dramatic storm sky and sun rays, but the camera left the glasshouse and the figure shrank (identity 0.36). Sky nouns in the fragment.

nostalgic.note: Sunset through teal glass, roses on the railing. Warm and wistful.

peaceful.note: Pale mist, soft light, calm water.

dark.note: A full-moon night with lanterns, but an exterior view and a small figure (identity 0.45). 'Night' pulled the camera outside.

ethereal.note: Soft luminous glow, blooms at the edges.

arcane.note: Four 546 worker-limit failures in a row; no render.

enchanted.note: Lantern-lit warm glow with petals on the path.

nightshade.note: Moonlit night, lanterns, dark coat. Gothic glamour exactly as written.

golden_hour.note: Sunset blazing through the glass. The best card of every round.

blue_hour.note: Cobalt glass, warm lamps, wet floor. Exactly blue hour.

moonlit.note: DERAILED: a TV news desk by the sea, no Kevin (identity 0.00). The early fragment can hijack the scene when the words are ambiguous.

stormlight.note: Teal storm light, wind in the fronds, saturated color.

festive.note: String lights and confetti. A party.

after_rain.note: Mist and a wet reflective floor.

spotlight.note: Purple stage lights, dark surroundings, one spot. A bit of a nightclub; tone the magenta down.

aurora.note: Aurora rippling through the glass, a fur-collared coat. Identity 0.56, a little low.

prism.note: Rainbow-tinted light and refractions, but the face aged (grey beard, identity 0.56).
